summary: MindWalk Holdings Corp. filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing it will report first-quarter fiscal year 2027 financial results on September 14, 2026, and host an earnings conference call and webcast. The filing provides logistical details for the call, including dates and registration URLs, and includes forward-looking statements and company background. No special-situation event such as acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or management change is disclosed. This is a routine earnings-date announcement under Form 6-K, equivalent to a standard current report, and warrants no special-situations classification.
